image_description: The image displays a crocodilian, likely a Nile crocodile, swimming in rippled water. Only the dorsal surface of the head and the upper ridge of the back/tail are visible above the waterline. The skin appears dark, rough, and textured with visible scutes. The snout is elongated, and the eye is positioned on top of the head. The rest of the body, including limbs and ventral scales, is submerged.
